name: Another Power Source?
label: Quest
description: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan has more power sources and will sell you another one, at a price of ten Wastewander Water Pouches.
intro: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan has more power sources and will sell you another one, at a price of ten Wastewander Water Pouches.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Let me guess - you didn't get whatever world-ending, nefarious deed you were doing done in time. No wait, better still... You dropped it in the sand! Well, whatever the reason, I do have additional power sources I will sell to you. This time, however, it will cost you ten, YES TEN Wastewander Water Pouches!
Times are tough all around, friend, and power sources don't grow on trees! Hrm, but what if they did. Maybe we could MAKE a power source tree...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well, have you got the ten water pouches?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very well, here is another power source. I highly recommend you using it properly this time, unless you are eager to spend ten more water pouches for another water source.
